items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: I know when I was a young man, they used to be right there on Main Street, you know. Uh-huh. And I thought Teo had the Norella that was born and raised here myself.

ctx.x: No, not then. They had a clarinet, I don't know. Saxophone. Old man Teo never did play in that band. Not playing, no. Uh-huh. Who's old man Teo? That's the name of the band. That's the Teo used to play with Peter Bukowski and his daddy.
His dad. He used to live here, you see. Born and raised here, Teo did.
There's papa and Lorenzo. Lorenzo's daddy. I think he was Lorenzo Junior. Yeah, I think so, but then they had another brother, papa. Yeah, another brother.
